answer: Because the timing is published against the pearl challenge, the nebula audit can replay the ocean history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 201 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 3142 identities would post 1426 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
